text:
alex: Heads up — PR ready for a quick cross-team review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/8462
alex: change is in autoscaler policy + KMS key reference, small diff but affects runtime startup path
morgan: @sasha_r fyi this touches the runtime bootstrap config you touched last week
sasha_r: looking now, will skim the config and the unit tests
ci-bot: CI passed — all checks green (unit, lint, e2e-smoke). Docker image built: gcr.io/redwood/runner:pr-8462
raj: security heads-up — there's a key ARN in the env config, is that the shared KMS or customer-scoped? @clare
clare: that’s the shared infra KMS (not customer data). I want to double-check IAM permissions before sign-off, give me ~30m
sasha_r: code looks fine, only comment is rename autoscaler.max_burst -> max_burst_capacity for clarity, will push a tiny lint commit if people are ok
alex: SGTM on the rename, push it pls. Also would like runtime + infra to ack so we can merge during tomorrow’s mid-day merge window
raj: quick question — will the KMS env var be present for private deployments? If not we should guard code and default to no-encrypt path
clare: good catch. If private deployments opt out of KMS we should not error. I’ll request a small guard in the startup logic; can do a patch on top of this PR or we can add to the next patch. Preference to patch now so we don't ship a regresssion
sasha_r: I can add the guard in a follow-up commit in this branch, will do it in the next 15m
morgan: @raj @clare if you both can give a thumbs in the next hour we can schedule merge for 13:00 PST tomorrow during the low-traffic window
clare: giving conditional +1 assuming guard commit lands and I verify IAM usage (will re-check after commit)
raj: +1 pending guard commit and a note in the PR description about rollout plan for Dedicated clusters
alex: thanks — @sasha_r please add the rollout note and the guard, then ping this thread. If both confirm, I'll merge tomorrow at 13:00 PST unless someone objects
sasha_r: added guard and PR description updated. pushed commit and linked the rollout checklist in the PR body
clare: rechecked IAM, looks good now. +1
raj: +1 from infra side. leaving a short comment about monitoring alert to watch for startup failures
morgan: thanks everyone, will mark in calendar for 13:00 PST merge window. :calendar:
alex: great — merging tomorrow if no last-minute issues. :thumbsup:
